explanation: Birds descend from small feathered theropods, the group that includes Tyrannosaurus. Crocodiles are the birds' closest living relatives but sit outside the dinosaurs.

claims.text: Birds are living dinosaurs: they descend from theropod dinosaurs and are classified within Dinosauria.
Crocodiles, lizards and tortoises are reptiles but not dinosaurs.
Birds evolved from small, feathered theropod dinosaurs, the group that also includes Tyrannosaurus.
Crocodilians are the closest living relatives of birds.
